rendered.subject: Building a Connection
rendered.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’ve been thinking about how to deepen the connection between your brand and our Instagram community. We envision a collaborative post designed to highlight the importance of your Direct Trade relationships [P9]. Imagine a visually compelling post that showcases the dedication you have to your producers, emphasizing the quality premiums and long-term commitments you’ve built. The post could subtly weave in a feeling of shared passion and appreciation for the craft of coffee making. It would be a chance to reinforce the value you place on these partnerships and foster a deeper appreciation for the unique experience Stumptown Coffee Roasters offers.

The BrandPilot team
